facts.statement: Free Realms released a new television advertisement, announced in French on the official site, showing activities such as flying on a dragon, biking, building a super house, wearing outfits and farming.
facts.quote: Avez-vous vu la nouvelle publicité pour Free Realms à la télé ?

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: A French-language official news item announcing a new Free Realms television advertisement. The ad is said to show activities players can enjoy in the game, including flying on a dragon, biking, building a house, wearing outfits and farming. The ad is also posted on the official free Free Realms Online YouTube channel.
